title: Oracle preparation from a bookmark
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, $f:\bbz\to\mathrm{Option}(\{0,1\})$, $p\in\bbz$, a Boolean side satisfying $p\ge0$ when true and $p\le0$ when false, an input-head position, and an output word. There is a time $t\le |p|+3$ at which the oracle-dispatch machine, started in the bookmark configuration, reaches the ready configuration with empty argument and copy state. At every earlier step $u<t$, its state is one of the bookmark state, the corresponding origin state, or the save state.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head position for $x$ is given
